Least-squares estimator with a sandwich standard error

estimate_beta.Rd

Fits model by least squares to all rows of data_yXZ. Use it with the true covariate (the oracle estimator, e.g. y ~ AX + Z) or with W in place of X (the naive estimator, y ~ AW + Z).

Usage

estimate_beta(data_yXZ, model)

Arguments

data_yXZ

A data frame containing the variables in model.

model

A formula, e.g. y ~ AX + Z.

Value

A list with beta_est (coefficients and sigma) and se_est (sandwich standard errors; NA for sigma).

Examples

set.seed(1)
dat <- data_aft(500)
estimate_beta(dat, y ~ AX + Z)
#> $beta_est
#> (Intercept)          AX           Z       sigma 
#>   0.9970664   1.0121563   1.0317915   1.0308559 
#> 
#> $se_est
#> (Intercept)          AX           Z       sigma 
#>  0.05562549  0.03800383  0.04344725          NA 
#>
